correctness.rationale: The proof establishes a complete orientation reduction for nonempty binary non-overlapping codes; reverse-complement orbits are exactly the admissible graph vertices, and mutual prefix/suffix conflicts are exactly its edges. For each n=2..16, certificates.json contains an explicit weighted independent set and an integer conflict-clique multicover whose cost equals the independent-set weight. The standalone standard-library verifier reconstructs the words and graph, checks every clique and coverage inequality, and confirms all fifteen primal/dual equalities. For every even n>=2 the unbordered RC-fixed 0^k1^k gives a code; for odd n>=9 the explicit pair 0^k1101^(k-2) and its RC is proved overlap-free, k=4 separately checked. At odd 3,5,7, the complete 2^(n-2) word search proves every possible orbit invalid. Mathematical finite and infinite scopes are separate.

value.rationale: The involution constraint is natural when synchronization codewords must be accepted in either complemented strand direction. It changes the feasibility phase diagram (odd lengths 3,5,7 impossible, all odd lengths >=9 possible), not merely a numerical constant. The complete optimality table through length 16 has matching, compact, solver-independent clique multicover certificates, providing exact design limits and a reusable finite method for a distinct combinatorial-code capacity problem.
